llm_evaluation.summary: Analysis of thesis_package revealed standard application event-handling logic utilizing the fetch API to make network requests based on incoming window/event messages. Static analysis flagged standard network flow boundaries, but no evidence of obfuscation, malicious data exfiltration, command execution, or defense evasion was detected. The activity is consistent with standard web package functionality and is classified as benign.
